title: Chicken in Creamy Dijon Mustard Sauce
summary: Tender chicken breasts are pan-seared and finished in a silky Dijon cream sauce with shallots and garlic. It’s a classic French-style dinner: savoury, gently tangy, and rich enough to serve with potatoes or rice.
steps: Season the chicken breasts with salt and black pepper, then lightly coat them in the cornstarch, shaking off any excess.
Heat the olive oil and butter in a large frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes on each side, until golden brown. Remove to a plate.
Lower the heat to medium. Add the shallots and cook for 2–3 minutes until softened, then add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds more.
Stir in the Dijon mustard, then add the water and scrape up any browned bits from the pan.
Pour in the double cream and bring the sauce to a gentle simmer. Return the chicken to the pan and cook for 6–8 minutes, turning once, until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
Stir in the lemon juice and parsley, taste, and adjust with a little more salt or pepper if needed. Serve hot with potatoes, rice, or steamed vegetables.
